# Soft-hyphen reference

Original fixture generated by `tools/soft_hyphen_fixture.py`. It uses Arial
12pt with exact 16pt lines and 45pt narrow paragraph regions. The reference application
was used for read-only export of `native.pdf`; `reference.json` records
native glyph positions and source/PDF hashes.

The reviewed PDF shows invisible unbroken soft hyphens, `extra-` / `ordinary`,
the last fitting break in `cooper-` / `ation`, a forced ordinary-word break,
kerning across an unused marker, an isolated marker and a trailing marker.
The reference application's PDF maps displayed discretionary-hyphen glyphs to U+FFFE. The raw
reference preserves that mapping; the browser comparison normalizes it to
hyphen-minus after visual verification. This is a PDF text-extraction detail,
not evidence of a reference/OOXML rendering divergence.
